assertion_results.text: Version impact table shows mixed results: 2.1.x versions marked YES (affected) and 2.2.x versions marked NO (not affected) based on lock file evidence
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md contains a Version Impact Table with 2.1.0 and 2.1.1 marked '**YES**' (h2 0.4.5, < 0.4.8) and all 2.2.x versions (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) marked 'NO' (h2 >= 0.4.8). The h2 versions are sourced from lock file checks (Cargo.lock via git show <tag>:Cargo.lock). The file explicitly labels this a 'Mixed Impact Analysis': '2.1.x stream ships a vulnerable version of h2 (0.4.5), while the 2.2.x stream ships the fixed version (0.4.8 or later)'.

assertion_results.text: Affects Versions correction includes only the actually affected versions (2.1.x versions), not the unaffected 2.2.x versions (Step 3.2)
assertion_results.evidence: affects-versions.md proposes correction 'Current: [RHTPA 2.1.0, RHTPA 2.2.0] -> Proposed: [RHTPA 2.1.0, RHTPA 2.1.1]'. It explicitly removes RHTPA 2.2.0 ('ships h2 0.4.8 -- not affected') and adds RHTPA 2.1.1 ('ships h2 0.4.5 -- affected'). The Jira mutation block shows versions set to only RHTPA 2.1.0 and RHTPA 2.1.1. No 2.2.x versions are included.

assertion_results.text: Remediation tasks are created only for the affected stream (2.1.x), not for 2.2.x which already ships the patched version (Step 8 Case A scoping)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md states 'Case B: Affected -- create remediation tasks for the 2.1.x stream only. The 2.2.x stream is not affected (all versions ship h2 >= 0.4.8). No remediation is needed for the 2.2.x stream.' Both tasks (upstream dependency bump and downstream propagation) target release/0.3.z (the 2.1.x branch). The pre-creation checklist confirms: '2 tasks for 2.1.x ... 0 tasks for 2.2.x (not affected).' No 2.2.x remediation tasks exist.

assertion_results.text: The analysis treats the issue as unscoped (no stream suffix) and checks ALL versions across all streams (Step 1 Stream scope resolution, unscoped path)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md states: 'Product version (PSIRT-claimed) | _(none -- unscoped, no stream suffix)_' and 'The issue summary ... contains no stream suffix in brackets.
